claim: Remote touch technology begins to emerge
originalWording: Remote touch technology begins to emerge

sources.title: The Age of Spiritual Machines — Ray Kurzweil (1999)
sources.locator: P02 Personal relationships in 2009, first clause of haptics/chat bullet

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source on Sources for attribution limits.

strict.criterion: Practical remote-touch devices begin emerging for ordinary interpersonal communication rather than remaining isolated university lab experiments.
strict.rationale: Kurzweil's 2009 personal-relationships passage predicted remote-touch technology beginning to enter ordinary human interaction. A single 2002 MIT/UCL force-feedback lab demonstration does not establish consumer emergence, and interpersonal remote touch remains niche or experimental even in 2026.
changedConditions: Requires practical consumer emergence beyond an isolated academic laboratory demo

evidence.title: Paterson: Feel the Presence—Technologies of Touch and Distance
evidence.note: Describes 2002 Boston–London virtual handshake and networked force feedback; supports emerging remote touch, not full-body realism.

evidence.title: Research prototype for thermal and pressure haptics
evidence.note: Local finger-scale multimodal haptics; not whole-body, all-sensation realism. Preprint status retained.

reference.criterion: Networked haptic technology begins moving beyond isolated laboratory demos into practical remote-touch use.
reference.rationale: The 2002 Boston–London virtual handshake and subsequent networked haptics research proved remote force feedback is technically possible before 2009, warranting Partial credit. We do not count a single university lab demo as full on-time fulfillment of remote touch emerging for personal relationships.

broader.criterion: Early networked haptic demonstrations prove remote touch across distance before 2009.
broader.rationale: Reading 'begins to emerge' generously as any successful long-distance networked haptic demonstration before 2009, the 2002 Boston–London virtual handshake meets the threshold.
changedConditions: Accepts a single academic lab demonstration as sufficient for 'begins to emerge'
